title: Mass Bounds for Confined Area-Minimizing Minimal Surfaces
summary: We establish codimension-independent mass bounds for geometrically confined area-minimizing rectifiable currents. In Euclidean space, we combine the confined-volume doubling theorem of Colding--Minicozzi with a current-theoretic squashing argument. This gives an affirmative answer to Lin's interior mass-bound problem for every algebraic projection multiplicity $Q$: the interior mass is bounded by $C(n)Q$, without an a priori mass bound at a larger scale.
